description: This file serves as the entry point for a Vue.js application, setting up the app instance, importing global styles, components, router, internationalization, and an authentication service. It also includes global error handling for module loading failures and unhandled promise rejections, which triggers a user session reset and redirect to the login page.

methods.name: error event listener
methods.description: Handles module loading errors, clears session, and redirects to login.

methods.name: unhandledrejection event listener
methods.description: Handles unhandled promise rejections related to dynamic module loading, clears session, and redirects to login.
